sources.title: After leaving Google, Jakob Uszkoreit started Inceptive to apply AI to drug development

profile_text.body:
Inceptive is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California. Its website describes the company as building foundation models of life, which it says extrapolate from data to design medicines for challenging diseases. The company says it works with partners over time to tune models, use data, and transfer knowledge, and that its team of scientists, AI researchers, and engineers works where wet and dry lab work meet. It states it is hiring across AI and biology.

A CNBC report cited by the company says Inceptive was started by Jakob Uszkoreit after he left Google, to apply AI to drug development.

The company's own site does not list specific product names, and no lawsuits, MCP servers, or other filings are recorded for it.
